description: Article level translation context. One brief is prepared per detected article before its paragraphs are translated, from the article's heading and the opening of its body text, and is carried by every batch belonging to that article. What counts as a heading and what counts as body text is not declared here: heading labels come from article_grouping.json through chain_detection.json, and body labels from body_labels in chain_detection.json, so one declaration of what a heading and a paragraph of running text look like serves the detector, the grouping walk and this pass alike. first_body_excerpt_chars bounds how much of the opening paragraph the request carries; a longer excerpt buys a better brief and a larger request, and the excerpt is cut on a character boundary rather than a sentence one so that the same article always yields the same request. max_attempts bounds how many times one article's brief is asked for before the article is translated without one; a brief is guidance and never a precondition, so the ceiling is low on purpose. The four max_*_chars and max_names bounds are applied to what a model returns: an over-long field is cut to its bound rather than refused, because a verbose brief is still usable guidance, while a field of the wrong type is refused outright and the article goes without a brief.
